# SmartFill domain language

Definitions below are extracted from this app's code and README, not a separate terminology interview. No head-only team terminology has been confirmed. Refine definitions in place; if replacing a term, record its replacement.

## Glossary

- **Mock data** — Fictional form values generated locally for an industry profile and region by [the mock module](src/lib/mock/index.ts).
- **AI fill** — Provider-generated form values using field context and instructions, with requests handled by [the background worker](src/background.ts).
- **Industry profile** — A named set of domain-specific mock-generation behavior defined in [profiles](src/lib/mock/profiles.ts).
- **Region** — A locale choice used for generated formats, defined in [regions](src/lib/mock/regions.ts).
- **Form area / scope** — The subset of detected page fields selected by [the region picker](src/lib/picker/regionPicker.ts) or recognized from saved memory.
- **Saved form** — A persisted picked area represented by `SavedForm` with field signatures, optional saved values and fill metadata in [memory storage](src/lib/memory/store.ts).
- **Field signature** — A normalized control kind, label and name used to recognize a field across visits in [signature matching](src/lib/memory/signature.ts).
- **Pinned value** — A saved field value deliberately retained across future fills, including new-value generation, using `SavedForm.pinned` in [memory storage](src/lib/memory/store.ts).
- **Fill same values** — The popup action that continues a recognized form using saved values and seed, coordinated in [the popup](src/popup.tsx) and [content script](src/content.ts).
- **New values** — The popup action that regenerates values while retaining pinned fields, coordinated in [the content script](src/content.ts).
- **Undo** — Restoration of the pre-fill state captured by `FillSnapshot` in [snapshot handling](src/lib/filling/snapshot.ts).
- **Safe Filling Mode** — The setting that protects sensitive fields and consent controls, represented in [settings](src/lib/settings.ts) and [sensitive-field handling](src/api/ai/sensitiveFields.ts).
- **Theme tokens** — Semantic colors and measurements owned by [tokens.ts](src/styles/tokens.ts), used by extension pages and injected UI.

## Decisions

- 2026-11-05 correction: remove only excessive padding. Keep compact content insets (popup 12px outside / 16px panel; settings 20px panels). Light mode is the default regardless of the browser or OS preference. This supersedes the earlier zero-padding decision.

- 2026-11-05: Remove interaction Record & replay completely. Voice dictation remains a separate feature. Remove outer page and panel padding while retaining the internal spacing of form controls.

- 2026-11-05: Rebuild the interface as a reusable theme and component system across popup, settings and injected controls; remove decorative gradients and inconsistent visual rules.
- 2026-11-05: Use the supplied consistency reference and the aisdkagents.com model-picker reference to guide neutral surfaces, restrained accent use, rounded controls and clear hierarchy; reference content does not become SmartFill behavior.
- 2026-11-05: Keep project skills under `.agents/skills/` for Codex and project documentation under `docs/`.
- 2026-11-05: The reference revision uses locally bundled Geist, monochrome background/foreground tokens, rounded panels and a shared 320px selection menu. This supersedes the earlier blue accent and restricted-pill visual rules; see [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md).
